create_kscript_generator: create a KScriptGenerator instance to produce random Kaleidoscope code files
build_timing_script: build a TimingScriptGenerator to generate a bash script that times toy-mcjit and toy-jit
generate_kaleidoscope_script: generate a random Kaleidoscope script with configurable function count and call weighting
set_call_weighting: set the probability of generating function calls instead of arithmetic operations
write_timing_call: write a timing call entry to the timing script for both MCJIT and JIT execution modes
